# WheelOS AI-readable content

> This file contains the current Chinese and English Markdown sources for retrieval.
> Read /site-index.json first for page type, status, bilingual routes and evidence IDs.
> Product specifications describe an offering, not independently verified performance.
> Verified or partially verified engineering claims require an evidence record.
> Current evidence registry records: 0.

## Retrieval protocol

1. Identify whether the question concerns product configuration, engineering guidance, verified evidence, roadmap, or community information.
2. Read the matching page in the user’s language and preserve its status_code, scope and limitations.
3. Use evidence/registry.json before calling a performance or safety claim verified.
4. If Chinese and English pages conflict, report both URLs and do not choose the more favorable claim.

## 像建房子一样推进项目

自动驾驶不是一次性交付的“黑盒”。我们建议把项目拆成场景调研、边界设计、车辆与传感器、软件与数据、回放验证、试点运行和扩展评估七个阶段。每个阶段都让客户看到输入、输出、指标、风险和未解决问题。

[查看七阶段交付流程、通过条件和试点指标 →](/solutions/delivery-process)

## 产品组合

WheelOS 当前的核心产品是[一体化自动驾驶开发套件](/solutions/integrated-autonomous-driving-kit)：它把计算、传感器、时间同步、基础软件栈和开发工具组合成可集成的低速自动驾驶平台。场景适配、现场标定、地图、培训和仿真测试属于项目服务，具体范围需要确认。

面向厂内物流、医疗物资、门店补货、仓储短驳和园区后勤等低速运输任务，提供经过预集成与测试的软硬件基础平台。标准套件参考价格为人民币 39,900 元起，并可根据项目增加现场标定、功能定制、高精度地图和仿真测试服务。

[查看解决方案与完整规格 →](/solutions/integrated-autonomous-driving-kit)

## 这个文档解决什么问题？

自动驾驶系统横跨传感器、时间同步、坐标系、定位、感知、预测、规划、控制、底盘和工具链。单独的概念说明很难回答工程问题：

- 为什么车辆在仿真中正常，实车却出现规划抖动？
- 多传感器数据的时间戳应该在哪里校正，如何证明校正有效？
- 一个方案是 WheelOS 已经实现的能力，还是仅仅是社区的设计建议？
- 当现象无法复现时，AI 应该先索取哪些日志和指标？

本知识库的目标是让这些问题有**可引用、可验证、可继续补充**的答案。当前内容会明确标注哪些信息来自仓库、哪些是待补充的实践记录；没有证据时不会伪造结论。

本站遵守四项原则：[AI 原生](/about/principles)、[强验证](/about/principles)、[产品边界清晰](/about/principles)和[双语对等](/about/principles)。如果没有可追溯实验，答案必须保持为“待验证”；产品规格也不能自动升级为验证结论。

## 给 AI 的使用方式

1. 先阅读[如何阅读本知识库](/about/how-to-read)，理解证据等级和回答边界。
2. 按问题现象进入[自动驾驶问题库](/knowledge/)，不要只按模块名搜索。
3. 回答时引用具体页面，并同时说明适用条件、验证状态和缺失信息。
4. 若仓库没有答案，输出“未知/待验证”，并按照页面中的最小复现信息提出下一步实验。

机器读取入口：[llms.txt](/llms.txt) · [完整机器读取索引](/llms-full.txt) · [结构化站点索引](/site-index.json)

[Open the full decision guide: priorities, value metrics, commercial models and fit checklist →](/en/solutions/applications)

## Build the project like a house

Autonomous driving is not a one-step black box. We recommend seven visible stages: application discovery, boundary design, vehicle and sensors, software and data, replay validation, pilot operation and expansion assessment. Each stage exposes inputs, outputs, metrics, risks and unresolved issues.

[View the seven-stage delivery process, exit criteria and pilot metrics →](/en/solutions/delivery-process)

## Product portfolio

The core product is the [Integrated Autonomous Driving Kit](/en/solutions/integrated-autonomous-driving-kit), which combines compute, sensors, time synchronization, a baseline autonomy stack and developer tools. Site adaptation, calibration, maps, training and simulation are project services whose scope requires confirmation.

## A faster route from prototype to real-world testing

Low-speed autonomous vehicle projects usually spend too much time aligning sensors, timestamps, drivers, coordinate frames, software modules and chassis interfaces. The WheelOS Integrated Autonomous Driving Kit turns those dependencies into a defined starting point.

## Designed for controlled environments

The kit is intended for engineering evaluation and deployment in manufacturing, healthcare, retail, logistics and campus transport tasks, as well as other controlled or semi-controlled sites. Typical platforms include low-speed delivery, logistics, patrol, cleaning, vending and special-purpose vehicles.

<div class="solution-callout">
  <p><strong>Clear scope:</strong> The kit is not a certified production autonomous-driving system. Site risk assessment, regulatory approval and vehicle-level functional safety remain part of the customer project.</p>
</div>

## Verified knowledge and product scope stay separate

WheelOS uses three principles: AI-native retrieval, evidence-gated knowledge and explicit product boundaries. A `Product specification` describes configuration and delivery scope. `Verified` requires a reproducible evidence record with environment, metrics, raw results and review.

Start with [how to use this knowledge base](/en/about/how-to-read), or read the [repository principles](/en/about/principles).

## Talk to an engineer before you specify the project

Send us the vehicle type, site, route, speed target, drive-by-wire interface and timeline. We will help identify the right configuration and the main integration risks.

## [zh-CN] 如何阅读 WheelOS 知识库和产品资料

<!-- source: about/how-to-read.md; route: /about/how-to-read; content_type: methodology; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: 如何阅读 WheelOS 知识库和产品资料
description: 理解 WheelOS 的 AI 检索入口、页面类型、证据门槛、产品边界和双语规则。
status: 仓库事实
content_type: methodology
keywords: [AI Agent, 检索, 证据等级, 产品边界, 双语]
---

# 如何阅读 WheelOS 知识库和产品资料

> WheelOS 区分“产品配置”“工程建议”“已验证结果”和“计划能力”。没有可追溯证据时，正确答案是“不确定”，而不是补全一个看似合理的结论。

## 先判断页面类型

| 页面类型 | 回答的问题 | 默认可信边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 产品与解决方案 | 可提供什么配置、如何集成、如何询价 | 以正式规格书和报价为准，不等于已验证性能 |
| 工程知识 | 在什么条件下应该怎么排查或设计 | 使用页面状态标签判断证据强度 |
| 实践与证据 | WheelOS 是否真正做过、结果是什么 | 只有登记记录才能作为 WheelOS 实践引用 |
| 路线图与社区 | 未来计划和组织方式 | 不代表当前已交付能力 |

## 证据等级

每个实践条目都应使用以下标签之一：

| 标签 | 含义 | AI 可以如何表述 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `仓库事实` | 可在当前仓库源码、配置、发布物或正式记录中直接找到 | “仓库目前明确记录……” |
| `产品规格` | 当前产品资料或正式报价中的配置、接口和服务范围 | “该配置包含……最终以报价为准” |
| `设计建议` | 工程上合理的方案，但没有 WheelOS 实验结果 | “可以尝试……尚未证明……” |
| `已验证` | 给出环境、步骤和结果，可由他人复现 | “在指定条件下已验证……” |
| `部分验证` | 只覆盖仿真、单模块或有限场景 | “在有限条件下有效，不能外推到……” |
| `待验证` | 假设、问题或缺少关键数据 | “目前无法判断，需要……” |
| `计划能力` | 路线图或未来目标 | “计划支持……当前不能作为已交付能力引用” |

## AI 回答的最小格式

回答自动驾驶工程问题时，优先输出：

1. **判断**：已知、未知，还是需要实验。
2. **内容类型**：产品规格、仓库事实、设计建议还是验证结论。
3. **最可能的原因**：按证据和排查成本排序。
4. **需要的数据**：日志字段、时间范围、坐标系、硬件和版本。
5. **实验步骤**：一次只改变一个关键变量。
6. **验收指标**：用数值或可观察条件定义成功。
7. **边界**：哪些场景、硬件、版本或报价配置不适用。
8. **引用**：链接到具体页面、证据 ID 或正式产品资料。

严禁把没有实验数据的建议写成“WheelOS 已支持”，也不要用“理论上可行”替代实车安全结论。

## 引用规则

引用时优先使用具体页面和证据 ID，而不是只引用首页。引用必须保留原文的状态、测试环境和限制条件。`llms.txt` 和 `site-index.json` 是导航，不是验证证明；`evidence/registry.json` 是验证记录索引，实践正文才是证据细节；产品配置不能替代实验证据。

## 如何提交一条新知识

请优先提交一个完整的问题记录，而不是孤立的结论：

```text
问题：可观察的现象
状态：产品规格 / 仓库事实 / 设计建议 / 部分验证 / 已验证 / 待验证 / 计划能力
环境：软件版本、硬件、车辆/仿真、数据集
输入：话题、频率、时间戳、坐标系、配置
尝试：具体命令或改动
结果：日志、指标、截图或回放链接
结论：有效/无效/部分有效
边界：尚未覆盖的情况
证据：代码、提交、数据或实验记录
```

## [en] How to read WheelOS product and engineering material

<!-- source: en/about/how-to-read.md; route: /en/about/how-to-read; content_type: methodology; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: How to read WheelOS product and engineering material
description: How to interpret product specifications, engineering guidance, reproducible evidence, page types and bilingual parity in WheelOS.
content_type: methodology
status: repository fact
keywords: [AI agent, evidence level, citation rules, reproducible experiments]
---

# How to read WheelOS product and engineering material

> WheelOS separates product specifications, engineering guidance, verified results, and planned capabilities. When traceable evidence is missing, the correct answer is "not established."

## Classify the page first

| Page type | Question it answers | Default evidence boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Product and solution | What can be supplied, how it integrates, and how to request a quote | Formal specification and quotation govern; this is not performance validation |
| Engineering knowledge | How to diagnose or design under stated conditions | Use the page status and scope |
| Practice and evidence | Has WheelOS actually performed and demonstrated the work? | Only registered records are practice evidence |
| Roadmap and community | What is planned, and how is the project organized? | Not proof of a delivered capability |

## Evidence levels

| Label | Meaning | Appropriate AI wording |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `repository fact` | Directly present in current source, configuration, release artifacts, or formal records | "The repository currently records..." |
| `product specification` | Supplier-provided configuration, interface, price, or service scope | "The supplier lists... final quotation required" |
| `design guidance` | Engineering reasoning without a WheelOS reproduction | "This may be tried, but is not yet demonstrated" |
| `verified` | Environment, steps, metrics, and artifacts are reproducible | "Verified under the stated conditions" |
| `partially verified` | Only a simulation, module, dataset, or limited scenario is covered | "Valid within this limited scope only" |
| `pending verification` | Hypothesis, question, or missing critical data | "The current evidence is insufficient" |
| `planned` | A roadmap target or future objective | "Planned, but not yet a delivered capability" |

These labels describe evidence strength, not marketing priority. A product specification and a verified result are different kinds of information.

## Minimum AI answer format

1. **Judgment**: known, unknown, or requires an experiment.
2. **Content type**: product specification, repository fact, design guidance, or verification result.
3. **Most likely causes**, ordered by evidence and diagnostic cost.
4. **Required data**: log fields, time range, coordinate frames, hardware, and versions.
5. **Experiment**: change one critical variable at a time.
6. **Acceptance metric**: define success numerically or through observable conditions.
7. **Boundary**: ODD, scenarios, hardware, versions, or quotation configuration where the result does not apply.
8. **Citation**: link to the exact page, evidence ID, or formal product source.

Never convert an unverified recommendation into "WheelOS supports this." Never substitute a simulation result for a real-vehicle safety conclusion.

## Citation rules

Cite specific pages and evidence IDs instead of the homepage alone. Preserve the original status, test environment, and limitations. `llms.txt` and `site-index.json` are navigation aids, not proof. `evidence/registry.json` indexes validation records; the practice record contains the evidence detail. Product configuration cannot substitute for experimental evidence.

## Submitting new knowledge

Prefer a complete problem record over an isolated conclusion:

```text
Problem: observable behavior
Status: product specification / repository fact / design guidance / partially verified / verified / pending verification / planned
Environment: software versions, hardware, vehicle/simulation, dataset
Input: topics, frequencies, timestamps, coordinate frames, configuration
Attempt: commands or changes
Result: logs, metrics, screenshots, or replay links
Conclusion: effective / ineffective / partially effective
Boundary: uncovered conditions
Evidence: code, commit, data, or experiment record
```

## [zh-CN] 仓库原则

<!-- source: about/principles.md; route: /about/principles; content_type: principle; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: 仓库原则
description: WheelOS 的中英文 AI 检索、证据分级、产品规格和自动驾驶安全验证原则。
content_type: principle
status: 仓库事实
keywords: [AI 检索, 证据等级, 可复现, SOTIF, ISO 26262, 产品规格]
---

# 仓库原则

WheelOS Docs 服务于两个对象：需要可靠资料的 AI agent，以及需要快速判断风险和集成路径的自动驾驶工程师。

## 四个最高优先级

1. **AI 可检索**：中英文页面具有稳定 URL、清晰元数据、问题入口和明确引用边界。
2. **验证优先**：事实、产品规格、设计建议、部分验证和已验证结论严格分层。
3. **产品边界清晰**：商业解决方案不能替代实验证据、安全论证或法规准入。
4. **双语对等**：中英文页面保持相同事实、数字、状态、证据 ID 和限制。

完整规范见 [`PRINCIPLES.md`](https://github.com/wheelos/wheelos.github.io/blob/main/PRINCIPLES.md)。

## 状态模型

| 状态 | 可以证明什么 | AI 不应说什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `产品规格` | 厂商声明的配置、价格、接口和服务 | 不能写成“独立验证的性能” |
| `仓库事实` | 代码、配置或正式记录存在 | 不能写成“已完成实车验证” |
| `设计建议` | 方案在工程上合理 | 不能写成“WheelOS 已支持” |
| `部分验证` | 指定仿真、模块或有限场景有结果 | 不能外推到量产或全场景 |
| `已验证` | 可复现实验及复核完整 | 不能省略环境、指标和边界 |
| `待验证` | 这是问题或假设 | 不能给出确定性安全结论 |
| `计划能力` | 路线图或未来目标 | 不能写成“当前已交付或已验证” |

## 一条可接受证据的最低要求

```text
结论 ID + 唯一证据 ID
+ 软件/配置版本
+ 硬件/车辆/仿真环境
+ 数据与场景
+ 基线和验收指标
+ 原始日志或工件
+ 失败样本与未覆盖范围
+ 复核者
```

没有证据 ID 时，AI 必须回答“当前无法判断”或“仅有设计建议”，并给出最小复现实验。

## 产品资料如何被引用

[一体化自动驾驶开发套件](/solutions/integrated-autonomous-driving-kit)属于 `产品规格`。AI 可以引用其参考配置、接口、参考价格和服务范围，但必须注明“厂商资料、最终报价和项目配置需确认”，不能把它当作独立测试报告。

## 内容准入

新增页面前，至少确认：

- AI 能否仅从页面判断内容类型、状态和适用范围？
- 是否说明了输入、指标、失败条件和不可外推部分？
- 中英文页面是否保持同一结论强度？
- 是否有稳定链接、机器元数据和证据入口？
- 是否把产品宣传、路线图和工程事实混在一起？
- 产品、应用场景和首页是否写清适合、不适合和下一步行动？

---

## [en] Repository principles

<!-- source: en/about/principles.md; route: /en/about/principles; content_type: principle; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: Repository principles
description: WheelOS principles for bilingual AI retrieval, evidence levels, product specifications, and autonomous-driving validation.
content_type: principle
status: repository fact
keywords: [AI retrieval, evidence level, reproducibility, SOTIF, ISO 26262, product specification]
---

# Repository principles

WheelOS Docs serves two audiences: AI agents that need reliable context and autonomous-driving engineers who need to judge risk and integration effort quickly.

## Four publication priorities

1. **Retrievable by AI**: every language version has stable URLs, explicit metadata, problem-oriented entry points, and citation boundaries.
2. **Evidence first**: repository facts, product specifications, design guidance, partial validation, and verified results are separate claim classes.
3. **Clear product boundaries**: a commercial solution cannot substitute for experimental evidence, a safety case, or regulatory approval.
4. **Bilingual parity**: Chinese and English pages preserve the same facts, numbers, status, evidence IDs, and limitations.

The full normative specification is [`PRINCIPLES.md`](https://github.com/wheelos/wheelos.github.io/blob/main/PRINCIPLES.md).

## Status model

| Status | What it establishes | What AI must not claim |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `product specification` | Supplier-declared configuration, price, interface, or service scope | Independently validated performance |
| `repository fact` | Code, configuration, or a formal record exists | Real-vehicle validation or production approval |
| `design guidance` | An engineering approach is plausible | WheelOS already supports it |
| `partially verified` | Results exist for a named simulation, module, dataset, or limited scenario | Generalization to production or all scenarios |
| `verified` | Reproducible experiment and review are complete | A result without environment, metric, and boundary |
| `pending verification` | A question or hypothesis remains open | A definitive safety conclusion |
| `planned` | A roadmap target or future objective | A delivered or independently verified capability |

## Minimum acceptable evidence bundle

```text
claim ID + unique evidence ID
+ software/configuration versions
+ hardware/vehicle/simulation environment
+ data and scenarios
+ baseline and acceptance metrics
+ raw logs or artifacts
+ failure samples and uncovered scope
+ reviewer
```

Without an evidence ID, an AI agent must answer that the outcome is unknown or that only design guidance is available, then propose the smallest useful experiment.

## How product information may be cited

The [Integrated Autonomous Driving Kit](/en/solutions/integrated-autonomous-driving-kit) is a `product specification`. AI may cite its reference configuration, interfaces, reference price, and service scope, but must state that the final quotation and project configuration require confirmation. It is not an independent test report.

## Content admission checklist

- Can an AI determine the content type, status, and scope from the page alone?
- Are inputs, metrics, failure conditions, and non-transferable scope explicit?
- Do the Chinese and English versions preserve the same claim strength?
- Are stable links, machine-readable metadata, and evidence entry points present?
- Are product claims, roadmap goals, and engineering facts kept separate?
- Do product, application and landing pages state what fits, what does not, and the next action?

## [zh-CN] 自动驾驶系统地图

<!-- source: about/system-map.md; route: /about/system-map; content_type: guide; status_code: design-guidance -->

---
title: 自动驾驶系统地图
description: 从传感器和底盘接口，经时间同步、感知、规划与控制，到验证的分层诊断地图。
content_type: guide
status: 设计建议
keywords: [系统架构, 时间同步, 坐标系, 规划, 控制]
---

# 自动驾驶系统地图

```text
传感器/底盘
    -> 驱动与消息接口
    -> 时间同步与坐标变换
    -> 定位 / 感知 / 预测
    -> 规划
    -> 控制
    -> 底盘执行与反馈

贯穿全链路：配置管理、可视化、日志回放、仿真、标定、监控与安全
```

排查问题时，先确认数据在哪一层首次偏离预期。不要直接从规划或控制参数入手：上游时间戳、坐标系、外参和底盘反馈错误，常会表现为下游“算法不稳定”。

## 关键接口问题

| 入口 | 首先确认 |
| --- | --- |
| 传感器 | 驱动是否发布、频率是否稳定、时间戳来自何处 |
| 消息 | 字段单位、坐标系、frame_id、序列号是否一致 |
| 定位 | 初始化、跳变、延迟和协方差 |
| 规划 | 目标、约束、地图/无地图模式和轨迹时间参数 |
| 控制 | 轨迹时延、车辆状态反馈、执行器限幅 |
| 验证 | 数据集、回放一致性、指标和失败样本 |

## 对标业界参考系统

| 系统 | 公开可见的结构性做法 | 对 WheelOS 的启示 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Apollo](https://github.com/ApolloAuto/apollo) | 模块化自动驾驶栈、车辆集成与标定、数据管线和仿真工具共同组织 | 产品资料应绑定版本、配置和集成前提，避免只列功能名 |
| [Autoware](https://docs.autoware.org/main/home/) | 核心包、扩展包和工具分层；组件接口清晰；覆盖安装、仿真、回放和场景测试 | 知识库按任务与接口组织，产品页明确标准配置和可选扩展 |
| [Waymo](https://waymo.com/safety/) | 强调安全案例、运营监控和大量真实/仿真验证的组合 | 单次演示不能替代安全论证；应披露验证层级、运营环境和剩余风险 |

这些公开做法支持同一个工程方向：**模块化接口、版本化配置、分层验证、可观测性和安全边界缺一不可**。本页是设计参考，不代表 WheelOS 已达到上述任何系统的验证规模。

公开参考：[Apollo repository](https://github.com/ApolloAuto/apollo) · [Autoware concepts](https://docs.autoware.org/main/design/autoware-concepts/) · [Autoware simulation](https://docs.autoware.org/main/simulation/) · [Waymo safety](https://waymo.com/safety/) · [Waymo safety case paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.01917)

---

## [en] Autonomous-driving system map

<!-- source: en/about/system-map.md; route: /en/about/system-map; content_type: guide; status_code: design-guidance -->

---
title: Autonomous-driving system map
description: A layer-by-layer diagnostic map from sensors and chassis interfaces through perception, planning, control, and validation.
content_type: guide
status: design guidance
keywords: [system architecture, time synchronization, coordinate frames, planning, control]
---

# Autonomous-driving system map

```text
Sensors / chassis
    -> drivers and message interfaces
    -> time synchronization and coordinate transforms
    -> localization / perception / prediction
    -> planning
    -> control
    -> chassis actuation and feedback

Cross-cutting: configuration, visualization, log replay, simulation,
calibration, monitoring, and safety
```

Start by finding the first layer where data deviates from expectations. Do not jump directly into planning or control parameters: timestamp, frame, extrinsic, and chassis-feedback errors upstream often appear as downstream algorithm instability.

## Key interface checks

| Entry point | First verify |
| --- | --- |
| Sensor | Driver publication, stable frequency, timestamp source |
| Message | Units, coordinate frame, `frame_id`, sequence continuity |
| Localization | Initialization, jumps, latency, covariance |
| Planning | Goal, constraints, map/no-map mode, trajectory timing |
| Control | Trajectory latency, vehicle-state feedback, actuator limits |
| Validation | Dataset, replay consistency, metrics, failure samples |

The map is diagnostic guidance, not evidence that every interface has been implemented or verified on a vehicle.

## Industry reference architectures

| System | Publicly visible structural practice | Implication for WheelOS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Apollo](https://github.com/ApolloAuto/apollo) | A modular driving stack is organized together with vehicle integration, calibration, data pipelines and simulation tools. | Product documentation should bind features to versions, configurations and integration prerequisites. |
| [Autoware](https://docs.autoware.org/main/home/) | Core packages, community extensions and tools are separated; installation, simulation, replay and component interfaces are documented. | Organize knowledge by task and interface; distinguish standard configuration from optional extensions. |
| [Waymo](https://waymo.com/safety/) | Public safety material emphasizes a safety case, operations and a combination of real-world and simulation validation. | A single demonstration cannot replace a safety case; disclose validation level, operating domain and residual risk. |

The shared direction is clear: modular interfaces, versioned configuration, layered validation, observability and explicit safety boundaries are all required. This comparison is design guidance; it is not evidence that WheelOS has reached the validation scale of these systems.

Public references: [Apollo repository](https://github.com/ApolloAuto/apollo) · [Autoware concepts](https://docs.autoware.org/main/design/autoware-concepts/) · [Autoware simulation](https://docs.autoware.org/main/simulation/) · [Waymo safety](https://waymo.com/safety/) · [Waymo safety case paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.01917)

---

## [zh-CN] WheelOS：项目与理念

<!-- source: about/wheelos.md; route: /about/wheelos; content_type: overview; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: WheelOS 项目与理念
description: WheelOS 的产品与知识定位、证据优先原则，以及商业解决方案与工程验证的边界。
content_type: overview
status: 仓库事实
keywords: [WheelOS, Wheel.OS, Wheel.App, 证据优先, 自动驾驶]
---

# WheelOS：项目与理念

## WheelOS 是什么？

WheelOS 同时提供面向园区低速自动驾驶的软硬件解决方案，以及面向开发者和 AI Agent 的工程知识与验证记录。公开内容分为产品与知识两条主线：

- **Wheel.OS**：核心中间件、消息接口、传感器驱动、车辆底盘，以及配置、可视化和底盘适配工具。
- **Wheel.App**：定位、感知、预测、规划、控制，以及标定、时间同步、车辆动力学和 Carla 集成工具。

这些名称和能力范围来自仓库的路线图。它们描述的是项目规划或目标，除非有源码、发布物或实践记录支持，否则不能直接理解为已交付能力。可采购的一体化套件则通过解决方案页面和正式报价单独描述。

## 理念：工程证据优先

WheelOS Docs 不是单纯的产品宣传页，也不是只罗列术语的文档站，而是一个可被 AI 查询的工程知识与产品知识系统：

1. **问题优先**：从车辆现象和工程约束出发，而不是从术语目录出发。
2. **证据分层**：明确区分仓库事实、设计建议、已验证实践、产品配置和待验证假设。
3. **可复现**：记录版本、硬件、数据集、配置、命令、指标和结果。
4. **允许失败**：失败实验同样重要，它能避免 AI 重复推荐无效方案。
5. **不越界**：仿真验证、封闭场地验证和量产安全论证是不同等级，不能互相替代。
6. **双语对等**：中文和英文页面保持相同事实、数字、状态和限制。

## 当前已知范围

目前仓库主要包含社区组织信息和路线图，自动驾驶模块的实现细节与真实车辆验证记录仍在持续补充。因此，AI 使用本仓库回答问题时，应把“路线图中的目标”与“代码或实验已经证明的能力”严格分开。

## 商业解决方案与工程证据的边界

[一体化自动驾驶开发套件](/solutions/integrated-autonomous-driving-kit)是 WheelOS 面向项目的软硬件解决方案页面，用于说明配置、交付范围和集成条件。它不能替代 `evidence/registry.json` 中的实验记录，也不表示套件已在所有车型、场地或法规环境下完成量产验证。项目适用性、最终配置和报价需单独确认。

## 相关入口

- [自动驾驶解决方案](/solutions/)
- [系统地图](/about/system-map)
- [路线图](/roadmap/2025)
- [组织结构](/organization/organization)

## [en] WheelOS: project and principles

<!-- source: en/about/wheelos.md; route: /en/about/wheelos; content_type: overview; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: WheelOS project and principles
description: WheelOS product and knowledge positioning, evidence-first principles, and the boundary between commercial solutions and engineering verification.
content_type: overview
status: repository fact
keywords: [WheelOS, Wheel.OS, Wheel.App, evidence-first, autonomous driving]
---

# WheelOS: project and principles

## What is WheelOS?

WheelOS provides integrated hardware and software solutions for low-speed autonomous vehicles, plus engineering knowledge and evidence for developers and AI agents. The public content has two product and knowledge tracks:

- **Wheel.OS**: core middleware, message interfaces, sensor drivers, vehicle chassis integration, configuration, visualization, and chassis adaptation tools.
- **Wheel.App**: localization, perception, prediction, planning, control, calibration, time synchronization, vehicle dynamics, and CARLA integration.

These names and capability areas come from the roadmap. Unless source code, a release artifact, or an evidence record supports a statement, it describes a target rather than a delivered capability. The purchasable integrated kit is described separately through its solution page and formal quotation.

## Evidence-first engineering

WheelOS Docs is neither a pure product brochure nor a terminology-only documentation site. It is an engineering and product knowledge system designed for AI retrieval:

1. **Problem first**: start from observed behavior and engineering constraints.
2. **Evidence levels**: separate product specifications, repository facts, design guidance, partial validation, and verified results.
3. **Reproducibility**: capture versions, hardware, data, configuration, commands, metrics, and artifacts.
4. **Retain failures**: failed experiments prevent AI from repeating ineffective recommendations.
5. **No boundary collapse**: simulation, closed-course testing, controlled operation, and production safety cases are distinct evidence levels.
6. **Bilingual parity**: Chinese and English pages preserve the same facts, numbers, status, and limitations.

## Current known scope

The repository currently contains community information, product solution material, engineering guidance, and roadmap content. Real-vehicle validation records remain limited. AI agents must keep roadmap goals separate from code, experiments, or delivered-product evidence.

## Commercial solution and evidence boundary

The [Integrated Autonomous Driving Kit](/en/solutions/integrated-autonomous-driving-kit) is a `product specification`. It explains configuration, delivery scope, and integration conditions. It does not replace an experiment in `evidence/registry.json`, a vehicle-level safety case, or regulatory approval. Applicability, final configuration, and price require project confirmation.

## Related entry points

- [Autonomous driving solutions](/en/solutions/)
- [System map](/en/about/system-map)
- [Roadmap](/en/roadmap/2025)
- [Organization](/en/organization/organization)

## [zh-CN] 实践证据索引

<!-- source: evidence/index.md; route: /evidence/; content_type: evidence; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: 实践证据索引
description: WheelOS 自动驾驶实验、复现步骤、结果、复核状态和适用边界。
content_type: evidence
status: 仓库事实
keywords: [证据, 注册表, 可复现, 复核, 安全边界]
---

# 实践证据索引

这是 AI 判断“有人是否真正做过”的首要入口。只有登记在 `evidence/registry.json` 且链接到完整记录的条目，才能被描述为 WheelOS 的实践证据。

## 证据门槛

一条记录至少要能回答：

- **谁/何时/在哪个版本**做的？
- **什么硬件、车辆或仿真环境**？
- **输入数据和配置**是什么？
- **如何复现**，原始日志或结果在哪里？
- **用什么指标判断成功**，基线和失败样本是什么？
- **结论适用于哪里，不适用于哪里**？

当前索引为空。这是有意的：在没有可核查实验材料前，宁可返回“尚无 WheelOS 验证”，也不把通用经验包装成真实验证。

解决方案页面中的配置、传感器参数、价格和服务范围属于 `产品规格`，不是本索引中的工程验证证据。

## 给 AI 的判定规则

`已验证` 必须同时满足：可定位的记录、固定版本/提交、可复现步骤、结果数据或日志、明确指标、边界与复核者。只满足部分条件时使用 `部分验证` 或 `待验证`。

机器读取：[registry.json](/evidence/registry.json)

问题页面目录：[catalog.json](/catalog.json)

## [en] Practice evidence index

<!-- source: en/evidence/index.md; route: /en/evidence/; content_type: evidence; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: Practice evidence index
description: WheelOS experiments, reproduction steps, results and applicability boundaries for autonomous-driving claims.
status: Repository fact
content_type: evidence
keywords: [evidence, registry, reproducibility, review, safety boundary]
---

# Practice evidence index

This is the primary place for AI to determine whether WheelOS has actually tested a claim. Only records in `evidence/registry.json` that link to a complete record may be described as WheelOS practice evidence.

## Evidence threshold

- Who performed the work, when, and against which version?
- What hardware, vehicle or simulation environment was used?
- What input data and configuration were used?
- How can it be reproduced, and where are the raw logs or results?
- Which metric determined success, and what were the baseline and failure samples?
- Where does the conclusion apply, and where does it not?

The current index is intentionally empty. Without auditable experimental material, the correct answer is "no WheelOS verification yet", not a generic recommendation presented as a verified result.

Product configuration, sensor specifications, price and service scope on solution pages are `Product specification`, not engineering evidence in this index.

## AI decision rule

`Verified` requires a locatable record, fixed version/commit, reproducible steps, result data or logs, explicit metrics, boundaries and a reviewer. If only some conditions are met, use `Partially verified` or `Pending verification`.

Machine-readable index: [registry.json](/evidence/registry.json)

Problem catalog: [catalog.json](/catalog.json)

## [zh-CN] AI 自动驾驶问题回答协议

<!-- source: knowledge/answer-protocol.md; route: /knowledge/answer-protocol; content_type: methodology; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: AI 自动驾驶问题回答协议
description: 使用 WheelOS Docs 分析自动驾驶问题时的固定判断、排查、验证和引用流程。
status: 仓库事实
content_type: methodology
keywords: [AI Agent, 故障排查, 引用, 证据, 产品规格]
---

# AI 自动驾驶问题回答协议

当 AI 使用本知识库设计方案、分析故障或评估产品时，必须按以下顺序工作。该协议的目的不是让回答更长，而是阻止未经验证的推测被当成事实。

## 1. 先建立问题对象

把用户描述转换成结构化信息：

| 字段 | 必须回答 |
| --- | --- |
| 现象 | 车辆或系统实际做了什么 |
| 期望 | 应该做什么 |
| 频率 | 每次、偶发、特定场景还是无法复现 |
| 边界 | 车辆/仿真、速度、天气、地图、传感器组合 |
| 版本 | WheelOS 提交、模块版本、配置版本 |
| 数据 | 话题、时间戳、坐标系、日志、回放 |
| 内容状态 | 产品规格、仓库事实、设计建议还是已有验证证据 |
| 风险 | 是否涉及执行器、道路安全或不可逆动作 |

缺少关键字段时，先输出需要补充的数据，不要直接给出确定性方案。

## 2. 按数据链路定位

优先查找首次偏离预期的层级：

```text
传感器 -> 驱动 -> 消息 -> 时间同步 -> 坐标变换
       -> 定位/感知/预测 -> 规划 -> 控制 -> 底盘反馈
```

不要因为现象出现在规划模块，就默认根因在规划模块。

## 3. 设计最小实验

一次只改变一个关键变量；保留基线；定义数值阈值；记录完整版本和配置；同时保留成功与失败样本。实验应优先选择可回放、可自动化、风险最低的环境，再逐步提升验证等级。

## 4. 输出结论

结论必须使用以下格式：

```text
页面类型：产品 / 知识 / 证据 / 路线图 / 社区
判断：产品配置 / 仓库事实 / 设计建议 / 部分验证 / 已验证 / 计划能力 / 当前未知
证据：页面 URL、证据 ID、仓库提交或正式产品规格
方案：具体改动和复现步骤
结果：指标、基线、样本量和原始工件
边界：未覆盖的硬件、场景、版本和安全限制
下一步：最小的补充实验
```

`已验证` 只能引用 `evidence/registry.json` 中的记录。没有证据 ID 时，不能使用“WheelOS 已验证”或“真实车辆已证明”等表述。产品页只能证明当前方案的配置与商务范围，不能单独证明安全、性能或场地适用性。

## 5. 双语与冲突处理

- 中英文页面应表达相同事实、数字、状态和限制。
- 如果英文与中文内容冲突，报告差异和两个页面 URL，不要自行选择更有利的版本。
- 产品规格、证据记录和知识页面的结论强度不同；发生冲突时，分别说明问题类型，不要合并成一个“已验证”结论。

---

## [en] AI autonomous-driving answer protocol

<!-- source: en/knowledge/answer-protocol.md; route: /en/knowledge/answer-protocol; content_type: methodology; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: AI autonomous-driving answer protocol
description: A fixed procedure for AI agents to classify, diagnose, validate and cite autonomous-driving problems in WheelOS.
status: Repository fact
content_type: methodology
keywords: [AI agent, troubleshooting, citation, evidence, product specification]
---

# AI autonomous-driving answer protocol

When AI uses this knowledge base to design a solution, analyze a fault, or evaluate a product, it must follow this sequence. The goal is to prevent unverified speculation from becoming a factual claim.

## 1. Define the problem object

| Field | Required information |
| --- | --- |
| Behavior | What the vehicle or system actually did |
| Expectation | What it should have done |
| Frequency | Every time, intermittent, scenario-specific or unreproducible |
| Boundary | Vehicle/simulation, speed, weather, map and sensor set |
| Version | WheelOS commit, module version and configuration version |
| Data | Topics, timestamps, coordinate frames, logs and replay |
| Content state | Product specification, repository fact, design guidance or existing evidence |
| Risk | Actuators, road safety or irreversible actions involved |

If critical fields are missing, request the missing data before giving a deterministic solution.

## 2. Follow the data path

Find the first layer where behavior departs from expectations:

```text
sensors -> drivers -> messages -> time synchronization -> coordinate transforms
        -> localization / perception / prediction -> planning -> control -> chassis feedback
```

Do not assume the root cause is in planning because the visible symptom appears there.

## 3. Design the smallest experiment

Change one critical variable at a time, preserve a baseline, define numerical thresholds, record complete versions and configuration, and keep both successful and failing samples. Prefer replayable, automatable and low-risk environments before increasing the validation level.

## 4. Output format

```text
Page type: product / knowledge / evidence / roadmap / community
Finding: product specification / repository fact / design guidance / partially verified / verified / planned / currently unknown
Evidence: page URL, evidence ID, repository commit or formal product specification
Approach: concrete change and reproduction steps
Result: metrics, baseline, sample size and raw artifacts
Boundary: uncovered hardware, scenarios, versions and safety limits
Next step: smallest additional experiment
```

`Verified` may cite only a record in `evidence/registry.json`. Without an evidence ID, do not use phrases such as "WheelOS has verified" or "proven on a real vehicle". `Product specification` may describe configuration and delivery scope, but cannot be upgraded to a verification conclusion.

## 5. Bilingual and conflict handling

- Chinese and English pages must preserve the same facts, numbers, status, and limitations.
- If versions conflict, report both URLs instead of choosing the more favorable statement.
- Product specifications, evidence records and knowledge pages answer different questions. Do not merge them into a single "verified" conclusion.

---

# Autonomous-driving knowledge base

Content is organized around problems AI agents and engineers actually encounter. Each page starts with a diagnostic path and then explains the principle. Areas without WheelOS evidence are explicitly labeled as guidance or pending verification.

| Observed symptom | Read first |
| --- | --- |
| Trajectory jitter, prediction mismatch, unstable fusion | [Sensors and time synchronization](/en/knowledge/sensors-and-time) |
| Vehicle offset in the map, wrong turn direction | [Localization, frames, and calibration](/en/knowledge/localization-and-calibration) |
| Feasible trajectory that the vehicle cannot track | [Planning, control, and chassis](/en/knowledge/planning-control) |
| Simulation works but real-world readiness is unclear | [Simulation, replay, and validation](/en/knowledge/validation) |

## Question template

Provide the symptom, reproduction frequency, vehicle or simulation environment, software commit/version, sensor models, input topics, timestamp source, coordinate frames, key logs, and acceptance metric. Without this context, the correct conclusion is usually `pending verification`.

## [zh-CN] 定位、坐标系与标定

<!-- source: knowledge/localization-and-calibration.md; route: /knowledge/localization-and-calibration; content_type: knowledge; status_code: design-guidance -->

---
title: 定位、坐标系与标定
description: 在调整算法参数前验证坐标系、单位、外参和定位时序。
content_type: knowledge
status: 设计建议
scope: 定位和多传感器坐标处理
keywords: [定位, frame_id, 外参标定, 坐标变换]
evidence_ids: []
---

# 定位、坐标系与标定

**状态：** `设计建议` · **关键原则：** 先证明坐标和标定，再调算法参数

## 最小检查集

- 每个消息的 `frame_id`、父子坐标关系和轴方向是否明确。
- 长度、角度、速度的单位是否统一。
- 外参的时间有效期、安装方向和坐标变换顺序是否记录。
- 定位输出的时间戳是否对应车辆状态，而不是处理完成时间。
- 轨迹、地图、感知目标和底盘反馈是否在同一参考系。

## 典型症状与假设

| 症状 | 优先假设 | 证据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 车辆整体平移 | 外参、初始位姿或地图坐标不一致 | 叠加轨迹和静态标志物 |
| 转弯方向反了 | 轴方向或角度符号约定错误 | 检查变换矩阵和右手系 |
| 速度/姿态偶发跳变 | 时间对齐或定位重置 | 对照状态序列和重置日志 |

这些是通用排查建议，不代表 WheelOS 已对所有车辆和传感器组合完成验证。

---

## [en] Localization, coordinate frames, and calibration

<!-- source: en/knowledge/localization-and-calibration.md; route: /en/knowledge/localization-and-calibration; content_type: knowledge; status_code: design-guidance -->

---
title: Localization, coordinate frames, and calibration
description: Verify coordinate frames, units, extrinsics, and localization timing before tuning algorithm parameters.
content_type: knowledge
status: design guidance
scope: localization and multi-sensor coordinate handling
keywords: [localization, frame_id, extrinsic calibration, coordinate transform]
evidence_ids: []
---

# Localization, coordinate frames, and calibration

**Status:** `design guidance` · **Core rule:** prove coordinates and calibration before tuning algorithm parameters

## Minimum check set

- Is every message's `frame_id`, parent/child relationship, and axis direction explicit?
- Are units for length, angle, and velocity consistent?
- Are extrinsic validity periods, mounting orientation, and transform order recorded?
- Does localization timestamp describe the vehicle state rather than processing completion?
- Are trajectories, maps, perceived objects, and chassis feedback expressed in the same reference frame?

## Typical symptoms and hypotheses

| Symptom | First hypothesis | Cheap evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Whole vehicle appears translated | Extrinsic, initial pose, or map-frame mismatch | Overlay trajectories and static landmarks |
| Turn direction is reversed | Axis or angle-sign convention error | Inspect transform matrix and handedness |
| Intermittent pose/speed jumps | Time alignment or localization reset | Compare state sequence with reset logs |

These are general diagnostics, not proof that WheelOS has validated every vehicle and sensor combination.

---

## [zh-CN] 规划、控制与底盘

<!-- source: knowledge/planning-control.md; route: /knowledge/planning-control; content_type: knowledge; status_code: pending-verification -->

---
title: 规划、控制与底盘
description: 当轨迹可行但车辆无法跟踪时，分离轨迹质量、传输延迟、控制行为和执行器限制。
content_type: knowledge
status: 待验证
scope: 规划、控制和底盘集成
keywords: [规划, 控制, 底盘, 延迟, 执行器限制]
evidence_ids: []
---

# 规划、控制与底盘

**状态：** `待验证` · **原因：** 当前仓库尚未提供足够的接口与实验记录

规划轨迹能够被生成，不等于车辆能够安全跟踪。分析“轨迹正常但车辆表现异常”时，至少要把以下延迟链拆开：

```text
规划生成 -> 消息传输 -> 控制计算 -> 底盘执行 -> 状态反馈
```

需要收集每一段的时间戳、轨迹的时间参数、车辆实际速度/转角、控制输出限幅和底盘故障状态。先用回放或封闭场地数据确定是轨迹质量、时延、模型误差还是执行器限制，再修改控制器参数。

WheelOS 路线图列出规划、控制和车辆底盘适配方向；在缺少具体版本、代码和实车指标时，AI 不应声称某个控制算法或车辆适配已经可用。

---

## [en] Planning, control, and chassis

<!-- source: en/knowledge/planning-control.md; route: /en/knowledge/planning-control; content_type: knowledge; status_code: pending-verification -->

---
title: Planning, control, and chassis
description: Separate trajectory quality, transport latency, controller behavior, and actuator limits when the vehicle cannot follow a valid path.
content_type: knowledge
status: pending verification
scope: planning, control, and chassis integration
keywords: [planning, control, chassis, latency, actuator limit]
evidence_ids: []
---

# Planning, control, and chassis

**Status:** `pending verification` · **Reason:** the repository does not yet contain enough interface and experiment records

A feasible trajectory does not prove that the vehicle can track it safely. For "the trajectory is valid but the vehicle behaves incorrectly," separate the latency chain:

```text
planning output -> message transport -> control calculation
                -> chassis actuation -> state feedback
```

Collect timestamps, trajectory timing, measured speed/steering, control limits, and chassis fault state for every stage. Use replay or closed-course data to determine whether the problem is trajectory quality, latency, model error, or actuator limits before changing controller gains.

The roadmap lists planning, control, and chassis-adaptation work. Without a specific version, code path, and vehicle metric, AI must not claim that a controller or chassis integration is already available.

## [zh-CN] 传感器与时间同步

<!-- source: knowledge/sensors-and-time.md; route: /knowledge/sensors-and-time; content_type: knowledge; status_code: design-guidance -->

---
title: 传感器与时间同步
description: 排查表现为多传感器融合不稳定的时间戳、延迟和同步问题。
content_type: knowledge
status: 设计建议
scope: 多传感器自动驾驶链路
keywords: [传感器时间戳, 延迟, PTP, 融合抖动, Cyber RT]
evidence_ids: []
---

# 传感器与时间同步

**状态：** `设计建议` · **适用范围：** 多传感器自动驾驶链路

## 常见问题

- 传感器消息频率正常，但融合目标出现拖影或跳动。
- 回放时结果稳定，在线运行时不稳定。
- 不同设备的时间戳看似都是 Unix 时间，却无法对齐。

## 排查顺序

1. 记录每条消息的采集时间、发布时间、接收时间和序列号，不要只看 ROS/中间件的一个时间字段。
2. 计算相邻消息周期、延迟分布和跨传感器时间差，观察均值之外的长尾。
3. 确认所有设备使用的时钟源、同步协议和时区/单调时钟语义。
4. 在固定数据集上回放，逐步改变时间偏移，确认算法对误差的敏感度。
5. 记录同步修正前后的指标，并保留失败样本。

## 不应直接下的结论

“时间同步解决了”至少需要一个可复现的环境、偏移量、修正方法和指标。当前 WheelOS 仓库路线图提到传感器时间同步工具，但本页不把路线图当作实现或实车验证证据。

---

## [en] Sensors and time synchronization

<!-- source: en/knowledge/sensors-and-time.md; route: /en/knowledge/sensors-and-time; content_type: knowledge; status_code: design-guidance -->

---
title: Sensors and time synchronization
description: Diagnose timestamp, latency, and synchronization problems that appear as unstable multi-sensor fusion.
content_type: knowledge
status: design guidance
scope: multi-sensor autonomous-driving pipelines
keywords: [sensor timestamp, latency, PTP, fusion jitter, Cyber RT]
evidence_ids: []
---

# Sensors and time synchronization

**Status:** `design guidance` · **Scope:** multi-sensor autonomous-driving pipelines

## Common symptoms

- Sensor rates look normal, but fused objects smear or jump.
- Replay is stable while the online system is unstable.
- Every device reports Unix time, yet messages still cannot be aligned.

## Diagnostic order

1. Record acquisition, publication, receipt, timestamp, and sequence number separately. Do not inspect only one middleware field.
2. Measure message-period distribution, latency, and cross-sensor time offset, including tail behavior rather than only averages.
3. Confirm each device's clock source, synchronization protocol, and time-zone/monotonic-clock semantics.
4. Replay a fixed dataset while sweeping offsets to quantify sensitivity.
5. Preserve metrics and failure samples before and after any synchronization fix.

## What cannot be concluded yet

Claiming "time synchronization is solved" requires a reproducible environment, measured offset, correction method, and acceptance metric. The WheelOS roadmap mentions synchronization tooling, but this page does not treat the roadmap as implementation or vehicle-validation evidence.

---

scope: 自动驾驶验证与确认策略
keywords: [仿真, 回放, SIL, HIL, 封闭场地, 安全论证]
evidence_ids: []
---

# 仿真、回放与验证

**状态：** `设计建议` · **仓库事实：** 路线图列出了 Carla 集成、可视化和调试工具方向

路线图列出 Carla 集成、可视化和调试工具方向。验证结论必须注明层级：

| 层级 | 能说明什么 | 不能说明什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 单元/接口测试 | 数据结构和局部逻辑符合预期 | 系统级实时性和安全性 |
| 离线回放 | 在固定数据和配置下可重复 | 在线时钟、驱动和执行器问题 |
| 仿真/SIL | 场景行为和接口联调 | 真实传感器噪声、底盘动力学和道路风险 |
| HIL | 实验室条件下的软硬件时序和接口 | 未建模的场地风险和整车行为 |
| 封闭场地 | 指定车辆与场景的实测表现 | 未覆盖场景和量产安全 |
| 受控运营/公开道路/量产 | 经批准的运营范围内的运行证据 | 对其他车辆、版本和法规环境的普遍保证 |

每次实验都应保留版本、配置、场景、随机种子（如有）、数据来源、指标、失败样本和结论边界。仿真、回放和封闭场地结果可以累积证据，但不能互相替代。

安全相关项目还应把 [ISO 26262](https://www.iso.org/standard/68383.html) 功能安全、[ISO 21448](https://www.iso.org/standard/77490.html) SOTIF，以及 UL 4600 安全案例方法作为参考框架。引用这些标准不代表 WheelOS 产品或本项目已经获得认证。

---

## [en] Simulation, replay, and validation

<!-- source: en/knowledge/validation.md; route: /en/knowledge/validation; content_type: knowledge; status_code: design-guidance -->

---
title: Simulation, replay, and validation
description: Map each validation level to what it can and cannot establish for autonomous-driving claims.
content_type: knowledge
status: design guidance
scope: verification and validation strategy
keywords: [simulation, replay, SIL, HIL, closed course, safety case]
evidence_ids: []
---

# Simulation, replay, and validation

**Status:** `design guidance`

Validation claims must state the evidence level:

| Level | Can establish | Cannot establish |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unit/interface test | Data structures and local logic | System real-time behavior or safety |
| Offline replay | Repeatability under fixed data and configuration | Online clocks, drivers, and actuators |
| Simulation/SIL | Scenario behavior and interface integration | Real sensor noise, chassis dynamics, road risk |
| HIL | Hardware/software timing and interfaces under lab conditions | Unmodeled site hazards and full vehicle behavior |
| Closed course | Named vehicle and scenario performance | Uncovered sites, production safety |
| Controlled operation/public road/production | Evidence under an approved operating scope | Generalization to other vehicles or regulations |

Every experiment should retain versions, configuration, scenario definition, random seed, data provenance, metrics, failure samples, and the exact boundary of its conclusion.

Simulation, replay, and closed-course success are cumulative evidence, not substitutes for one another.

Safety-related projects should also use [ISO 26262](https://www.iso.org/standard/68383.html) functional safety, [ISO 21448](https://www.iso.org/standard/77490.html) SOTIF, and UL 4600 safety-case methods as reference frameworks. Referencing these standards does not mean that a WheelOS product or this repository is certified.

## [zh-CN] WheelOS 开源社区结构

<!-- source: organization/organization.md; route: /organization/organization; content_type: organization; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: 社区组织结构
description: WheelOS 开源社区的技术委员会、运营委员会、贡献者和协作方式。
status: 仓库事实
content_type: organization
keywords: [WheelOS, 开源社区, 治理, 协作方式]
---

# WheelOS 开源社区结构

## 技术指导委员会（TSC）

- **职责：** 负责项目技术方向、代码质量、发布规划和技术决策。
- **成员：** 核心贡献者、模块维护者和资深技术专家。
- **工作方式：**
  - 定期召开技术会议，例如每周或每月一次。
  - 审查 Pull Request 和 Issue。
  - 组织技术分享并与社区保持互动。

## 运营委员会

- **职责：** 管理社区非技术事务，包括推广、资源管理和活动组织。
- **成员：** 社区经理、设计师、市场专家和活跃用户代表。
- **工作方式：**
  - 规划 Hackathon、年度峰会等社区活动。
  - 推广社区项目，吸引新用户和贡献者。
  - 管理资金资源并协调赞助方。
  - 支持 Slack、论坛等协作工具的日常运行。

## 贡献者

- **职责：**
  - 提交代码、文档、缺陷报告或优化建议。
  - 通过提案参与社区技术决策。
  - 在技术分享和社区论坛中交流经验。
- **沟通方式：** 通过 GitHub、Slack 和邮件列表与模块维护者或技术委员会协作。

## 协作模式与流程

### 长期例行工作

- **技术委员会：**
  - 定期更新技术路线图。
  - 维护核心代码库。
  - 定期开展技术评审会议。
- **运营委员会：**
  - 定期规划技术分享、社区峰会等活动。
  - 持续更新推广渠道内容。
  - 跟踪社区增长指标，例如新用户和新贡献者数量。

### 短期项目制工作

- **技术委员会：**
  - 准备版本发布，例如 Alpha、Beta 和 Final。
  - 设计并实现新功能模块或重大技术改进。
- **运营委员会：**
  - 组织大型推广活动，例如年度开发者大会。
  - 针对特定用户群体开展反馈调查和策略调整。

## 维护技术氛围

- **清晰的技术规范：** 公开代码风格、贡献流程和技术决策机制。
- **开放透明的决策：** 通过会议纪要、公开讨论和 Issue 让社区理解决策依据。
- **贡献认可：** 为核心贡献者等角色建立公开认可机制。
- **教育与培训：** 通过技术分享、在线课程和开发文档降低新贡献者的参与门槛。

## 社区推广方式

- 在 LinkedIn、YouTube、微信公众号等渠道发布更新和教程。
- 通过博客、案例研究和行业文章展示工程进展。
- 组织 Hackathon、Meetup 和线上技术分享。
- 参与行业展会并与其他社区联合举办活动。
- 与高校、企业和开发者组织合作推广项目。

清晰的职责分工、透明的决策机制和持续的工程交流，是社区保持技术活力并吸引贡献者的基础。

---

## [en] WheelOS open-source community structure

<!-- source: en/organization/organization.md; route: /en/organization/organization; content_type: organization; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: Community organization
description: WheelOS technical steering, operations, contributors and collaboration model.
status: Repository fact
content_type: organization
keywords: [WheelOS, open-source community, governance, collaboration]
---

# WheelOS open-source community structure

## Technical Steering Committee

- **Responsibilities:** technical direction, code quality, release planning and technical decisions.
- **Members:** core contributors, module maintainers and senior technical experts.
- **Working method:** regular technical meetings, pull-request and issue review, and technical sharing with the community.

## Operations Committee

- **Responsibilities:** non-technical community operations including outreach, resource management and events.
- **Members:** community managers, designers, marketing specialists and active user representatives.
- **Working method:** plan hackathons and summits, promote projects, manage funding and sponsor relationships, and maintain collaboration tools such as Slack and forums.

## Contributors

Contributors submit code, documentation, defect reports and optimization proposals; participate in technical decisions through proposals; and share experience through meetings and forums. Collaboration happens through GitHub, Slack and mailing lists.

## Long-term and project work

- The Technical Committee maintains the roadmap and core codebase and runs technical reviews.
- The Operations Committee runs events, updates communication channels and tracks community growth.
- Project-based work prepares releases, implements major modules and runs user research and campaigns.

## Maintaining technical quality

- Publish code style, contribution and technical-decision processes.
- Make meeting notes and discussions public.
- Recognize core contributors.
- Lower participation barriers through sharing sessions, courses and documentation.

## Community outreach

Use LinkedIn, YouTube and relevant regional channels for updates and tutorials; publish blogs, case studies and industry articles; run hackathons and meetups; participate in industry events; and collaborate with universities, companies and developer communities.

## [zh-CN] 待验证假设

<!-- source: practice/hypotheses.md; route: /practice/hypotheses; content_type: evidence; status_code: pending-verification -->

---
title: 待验证假设
description: 可用于设计实验、但不能作为 WheelOS 已验证能力推荐的工程假设。
content_type: evidence
status: 待验证
keywords: [假设, 时间戳, 标定, 控制延迟]
---

# 待验证假设

这里收集合理但尚未由 WheelOS 实验确认的判断。它们可以帮助 AI 设计实验，但不能作为已支持能力推荐给用户。

| 假设 | 需要的验证 |
| --- | --- |
| 时间偏移是多传感器融合抖动的主要原因 | 固定数据集、扫描多个偏移量并比较融合误差 |
| 坐标系/外参错误是轨迹整体偏移的原因 | 静态标志物、变换树和独立测量交叉验证 |
| 控制振荡来自端到端延迟 | 记录全链路时间戳，比较不同延迟下的闭环指标 |

---

## [en] Pending hypotheses

<!-- source: en/practice/hypotheses.md; route: /en/practice/hypotheses; content_type: evidence; status_code: pending-verification -->

---
title: Pending hypotheses
description: Plausible but unverified judgments that can guide experiments but must not be recommended as supported capabilities.
status: Pending verification
content_type: evidence
keywords: [hypotheses, timestamp, calibration, control latency]
---

# Pending hypotheses

These hypotheses are plausible but have not been confirmed by WheelOS experiments. They can help AI design tests, but cannot be recommended as supported capabilities.

| Hypothesis | Required validation |
| --- | --- |
| Time offset is the main cause of multi-sensor fusion jitter | Fix the dataset, sweep offsets and compare fusion error |
| Coordinate-frame or extrinsic error causes the whole trajectory to shift | Cross-check static landmarks, transform trees and independent measurements |
| Control oscillation comes from end-to-end latency | Record the full timestamp chain and compare closed-loop metrics at different delays |

---

## [zh-CN] 实践记录

<!-- source: practice/index.md; route: /practice/; content_type: practice; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: 实践记录
description: WheelOS 实践记录规则、证据升级条件和结果保留要求。
content_type: practice
status: 仓库事实
keywords: [实践记录, 证据, 可复现, 验证]
---

# 实践记录

实践记录是本知识库最重要的证据来源。只有带环境、步骤和结果的记录，才能从 `设计建议` 升级为 `已验证` 或 `部分验证`。正式证据统一登记在[实践证据索引](/evidence/)。

## 记录规则

- 一个记录只回答一个可验证的问题。
- 结论必须绑定版本、硬件和数据，不写脱离条件的“支持”。
- 失败结果和未复现结果照样保留。
- 安全相关结论必须说明测试边界，不能用仿真结果替代安全论证。

入口：[已验证方案](/practice/verified) · [待验证假设](/practice/hypotheses) · [实践记录模板](/evidence/record-template)

---

## [en] Practice records

<!-- source: en/practice/index.md; route: /en/practice/; content_type: practice; status_code: repository-fact -->

---
title: Practice records
description: WheelOS rules for recording experiments and promoting guidance to verified evidence.
status: Repository fact
content_type: practice
keywords: [practice records, evidence, reproducibility, validation]
---

# Practice records

Practice records are the primary evidence source for this knowledge base. Only records with environment, procedure and results can move a topic from `Design guidance` to `Partially verified` or `Verified`. Formal records are indexed in the [evidence index](/en/evidence/).

## Recording rules

- One record answers one falsifiable question.
- A conclusion is bound to versions, hardware and data; avoid context-free "supported" claims.
- Retain failed and unreproduced results.
- Safety-related conclusions must state the test boundary; simulation cannot replace a safety case.

Entry points: [Verified solutions](/en/practice/verified) · [Pending hypotheses](/en/practice/hypotheses) · [Evidence template](/en/evidence/record-template)

## [zh-CN] Apollo Lite 资源下载

<!-- source: resources/index.md; route: /resources/; content_type: resources; status_code: repository-fact -->

title: Apollo Lite 资源下载
description: Apollo Lite 的模型、感知、规划、控制、标定、工程工具和数据地图服务入口。
status: 仓库事实
content_type: resources
keywords: [Apollo Lite, 感知模型, 规划控制, 标定, 工程工具]
---

# Apollo Lite 资源下载

这里面向 [Apollo Lite](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite) 的开发、集成、标定与验证，整理 Lite 工程中实际支持的模型、功能算法、工具包，以及 WheelOS 自有的数据和地图服务。

资源条目优先链接到 Apollo Lite 的代码、配置和文档；服务类资源预留 WheelOS 服务入口，不把尚未公开的地址伪装成可下载链接。页面中的“已实现”表示代码或配置存在，不等同于在所有车型和道路环境中完成量产验证。

## 按开发任务查找

| 任务 | 资源入口 |
| --- | --- |
| 准备感知模型和推理配置 | [模型](#模型与推理资源) |
| 开启地面检测、车道线或障碍物感知 | [感知算法包](#感知算法包) |
| 开发精准停车和无地图规划 | [规划与停车算法包](#规划与停车算法包) |
| 做车辆动力学、横纵向控制标定 | [标定与控制算法包](#标定与控制算法包) |
| 采集、回放、可视化和排查问题 | [工程工具](#工程工具) |
| 获取车辆数据或生成地图 | [WheelOS 数据服务](#wheelos-数据服务) · [WheelOS 地图服务](#wheelos-地图服务) |

## 模型与推理资源

以下条目对应 Lite 中的模型文件、模型配置或推理适配代码。下载模型时应同时获取对应的 `conf`、传感器参数和模型版本，不能只替换一个权重文件。

| 资源 | Lite 中的用途 | 主要内容 | 入口 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 相机障碍物模型 | 相机障碍物检测 | YOLO、YOLOv4、SMOKE 检测器及后处理 | [perception/camera](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/camera) · [模型配置](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/production/data/perception/camera/models) |
| 相机车道线模型 | 车道线检测和车道线标定 | Lane、DarkSCNN、Denseline 后处理 | [lane 模块](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/lane) · [相机模型](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/production/data/perception/camera/models/lane_detector) |
| 交通灯模型 | 交通灯检测与识别 | 检测、识别模型及生产配置 | [交通灯配置](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/production/data/perception/camera/models/traffic_light_detection) · [识别配置](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/production/data/perception/camera/models/traffic_light_recognition) |
| LiDAR 障碍物模型 | 点云障碍物检测和分割 | CNNSEG、NCUT、中心点和时空地面检测相关配置 | [LiDAR 感知](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/lidar) · [LiDAR 模型配置](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/production/data/perception/lidar/models) |
| 相机语义分割模型 | 相机语义分割推理 | SegFormer 的 ONNX/TensorRT 导出和构建工具 | [camera_semantic_segmentation](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/camera_semantic_segmentation) |

**模型条目建议字段：**传感器和内参、类别定义、输入尺寸、推理后端、TensorRT/CUDA 版本、显存、单帧时延、模型校验和、训练/评测范围和已知失效场景。

## 感知算法包

这些是按 Lite 功能组织的算法包，不是泛化的开源算法推荐。

| 功能包 | 能力范围 | Lite 代码入口 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 地面检测 | LiDAR 地面服务、地面服务检测器、时空地面检测和地面分割 | [ground_detector](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/lidar/lib/ground_detector) · [ground service](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/lidar/lib/scene_manager/ground_service) |
| 障碍物检测 | 相机、LiDAR、BEV 障碍物检测和离线检测 | [camera obstacle](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/camera/lib/obstacle) · [LiDAR detector](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/lidar/lib/detector) |
| 障碍物跟踪与融合 | OMT/OMT2、多 LiDAR 融合、概率融合 | [tracking](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/camera/lib/obstacle/tracker) · [fusion](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/fusion) |
| 车道线感知 | UFLDv2、DarkSCNN、Denseline 及车道线标定 | [lane](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/lane) · [lane perception](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/camera/lib/lane) |
| 交通灯感知 | 交通灯检测、识别、预处理和可视化 | [traffic light](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/camera/lib/traffic_light) |
| 定位 | NDT、MSF、RTK 及定位健康监控 | [localization](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/localization) · [localization health](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/localization_health) |

## 规划与停车算法包

| 功能包 | 能力范围 | Lite 代码入口 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 精准停车 | 开放空间规划、泊车多挡位搜索、曲率约束轨迹平滑和碰撞安全检查 | [open_space_planning](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/open_space_planning) · [停车规划](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/planning/open_space/parking) |
| 无地图/开放空间规划 | Skeleton Corridor、Hybrid A*、轨迹规划、轨迹验证和安全降级 | [开放空间规划说明](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/blob/main/modules/open_space_planning/README.md) |
| 参考线规划 | 车道跟随、交通规则、场景和任务规划 | [planning](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/planning) |
| 路由与相对地图 | 路由拓扑、相对地图和导航模式 | [routing](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/routing) · [relative map](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/world_model/relative_map) |

## 标定与控制算法包

| 功能包 | 能力范围 | Lite 代码/工具入口 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 动力学标定 | 执行器标定、横向车辆动力学测试、计划生成、CyberRT 采集、离线分析 | [whl-dyn](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/whl-dyn) · [工具说明](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/blob/main/wheelos-service/context/modules/tools/whl-dyn-open-loop-calibration-tool.md) |
| 横纵向控制 | MPC、纵向控制、横向控制、控制标定表和控制回放 | [control](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/control) · [控制配置](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/control/conf) |
| 传感器标定 | 相机、LiDAR、车道线和坐标变换相关标定 | [标定模块](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/calibration) · [sensor_calibration.sh](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/blob/main/scripts/sensor_calibration.sh) |

## 工程工具

| 工具 | 用途 | 入口 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `whl-dyn` | 动力学标定、测试计划、数据采集、离线指标和 Streamlit 工作台 | [whl-dyn README](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/whl-dyn) |
| `whl-debug` | 控制器调试、线上/离线数据提取和问题定位 | [whl-debug](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/tools/whl-debug) |
| `whl-tools` | 相机语义分割、图像消息发布、车道线调试可视化 | [whl-tools](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/tools/whl-tools) |
| `whl_toolbox` | 点云、SLAM、传感器和运行时数据的可视化工具箱 | [whl_toolbox](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/tools/whl_toolbox) |
| `whl-can` | CAN 自动测试、静态/动态用例和车辆接口验证 | [whl-can](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/tools/whl-can) |
| `whl-mock` | 路由、交通灯等输入消息的模拟发布 | [whl-mock](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/tools/whl-mock) |
| 地图工具 | 从 Mobileye、XY 等来源生成地图，以及路由拓扑图生成 | [map/tools](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/map/tools) · [脚本](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/scripts) |
| 录制与回放 | CyberRT 录制、消息记录、地图数据采集和回放启动 | [recording_launcher.py](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/blob/main/scripts/recording_launcher.py) · [record_map_data.py](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/blob/main/scripts/record_map_data.py) |

## WheelOS 数据服务

数据服务应作为 WheelOS 的自有产品提供，不把原始车辆数据直接散落在 Git 仓库中。建议从以下服务入口开始建设：

| 服务 | 面向对象 | 建议提供的能力 | 当前状态 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 数据集目录服务 | 算法、标定、测试开发 | 按车型/传感器/场景/版本检索，返回数据集 ID、时间范围、话题、格式、大小和权限 | 服务入口待接入 |
| 原始记录服务 | 数据和测试工程师 | CyberRT/MCAP 记录上传、分片下载、断点续传、校验和和生命周期管理 | 服务入口待接入 |
| 标注与样本服务 | 感知算法开发 | 样本筛选、标注版本、导出 Lite 所需格式、训练/验证集冻结 | 服务入口待接入 |
| 回放与评测服务 | 算法验证 | 选择记录、绑定代码提交和配置，运行离线回放并输出指标 | 服务入口待接入 |
| 模型制品服务 | 模型和部署工程师 | 模型、推理配置、TensorRT engine、校验和、硬件/驱动兼容关系 | 服务入口待接入 |

建议 API 返回统一的 `resource_id`、`version`、`source_commit`、`format`、`checksum`、`license`、`access`、`created_at` 和 `expires_at`，让下载、回放和证据记录可以互相追溯。

## WheelOS 地图服务

地图服务应围绕 Lite 的定位、路由、感知 ROI、开放空间规划和精准停车提供版本化地图，而不是只提供一个静态压缩包。

| 服务 | 面向能力 | 建议提供的内容 | 当前状态 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 地图目录服务 | 地图发现和版本选择 | 区域、坐标系、覆盖范围、版本、更新时间、适配车型和变更记录 | 服务入口待接入 |
| HD Map 下载服务 | 定位、路由和参考线规划 | `base_map`、`routing_map`、`sim_map`、拓扑图和生成元数据 | 服务入口待接入 |
| 停车场地图服务 | 精准停车和开放空间规划 | 停车位、车道边界、禁行区、目标位姿、ROI 和场景配置 | 服务入口待接入 |
| 地图检查与转换服务 | 地图上线前验证 | 格式转换、坐标系检查、拓扑检查、规划可用性和差异报告 | 服务入口待接入 |

地图条目至少应携带坐标系、原点、投影、车辆约束、生成工具版本、输入数据日期、覆盖边界、校验和和回滚版本。地图版本必须与回放记录、规划配置和车辆标定关联。

## 资源目录建设建议

1. **以 Lite 能力为准建目录：**资源只从 `modules/`、`whl-dyn/`、`scripts/` 和 `wheelos-service/` 的实际能力抽取，不再维护无关的通用数据集推荐。
2. **把“模型”和“算法包”分开：**模型是权重、推理配置和部署制品；算法包是可运行的感知、定位、规划、控制或停车功能。
3. **服务与代码分开发布：**代码通过 Git 仓库和版本发布，数据/地图通过 WheelOS 服务按权限和版本下载。
4. **以任务组织入口：**用户优先按“地面检测、精准停车、动力学标定、回放验证”等任务找到资源，再进入模块目录。
5. **保留可复现关系：**每次下载都绑定 Apollo Lite commit、配置版本、模型版本、地图版本、车辆标定和评测结果。

这套结构仍然延续 [Horizon 开发者文档](https://developer.horizon.auto/docs/) 的平台化思路，但将资源边界收敛到 Apollo Lite 的“模型—算法—工具—数据服务—地图服务”闭环。

## [en] Apollo Lite resources

# Apollo Lite resources

This page organizes the models, algorithms, tools, datasets and map services used for development, integration, calibration and validation around [Apollo Lite](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite). Resources link primarily to source, configuration and documentation. Services that are not public are marked as pending rather than presented as downloadable assets.

`Implemented` means that source or configuration exists. It does not mean that the capability has completed production validation for every vehicle or operating environment.

## Find resources by task

| Task | Entry point |
| --- | --- |
| Prepare perception models and inference configuration | [Models and inference](#models-and-inference) |
| Enable ground, lane or obstacle perception | [Perception packages](#perception-packages) |
| Develop precision parking and mapless planning | [Planning and parking](#planning-and-parking) |
| Calibrate vehicle dynamics and longitudinal/lateral control | [Calibration and control](#calibration-and-control) |
| Record, replay, visualize and debug | [Engineering tools](#engineering-tools) |
| Obtain vehicle data or generate maps | [WheelOS data services](#wheelos-data-services) · [WheelOS map services](#wheelos-map-services) |

## Models and inference

Download the associated `conf`, sensor parameters and model version with each model. Replacing a weight file alone is not a valid deployment procedure.

| Resource | Apollo Lite use | Contents | Entry |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Camera obstacle models | Camera obstacle detection | YOLO, YOLOv4, SMOKE detectors and postprocessing | [Camera perception](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/camera) · [Model configuration](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/production/data/perception/camera/models) |
| Camera lane models | Lane detection and calibration | Lane, DarkSCNN and Denseline postprocessing | [Lane module](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/lane) · [Lane model](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/production/data/perception/camera/models/lane_detector) |
| Traffic-light models | Detection and recognition | Detection, recognition and production configuration | [Detection configuration](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/production/data/perception/camera/models/traffic_light_detection) · [Recognition configuration](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/production/data/perception/camera/models/traffic_light_recognition) |
| LiDAR obstacle models | Point-cloud detection and segmentation | CNNSEG, NCUT, center-based and spatio-temporal ground detection | [LiDAR perception](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/lidar) · [LiDAR model configuration](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/perception/production/data/perception/lidar/models) |
| Camera semantic segmentation | Semantic segmentation inference | SegFormer ONNX/TensorRT export and build tools | [camera_semantic_segmentation](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/camera_semantic_segmentation) |

Recommended model metadata: sensor and intrinsics, class definitions, input dimensions, inference backend, TensorRT/CUDA version, memory use, latency, checksum, training/evaluation scope and known failure cases.

| Localization | NDT, MSF, RTK and localization health monitoring | [Localization](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/localization) · [Localization health](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/localization_health) |

| Sensor calibration | Camera, LiDAR, lane and coordinate-transform calibration | [Calibration](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/calibration) · [sensor_calibration.sh](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/blob/main/scripts/sensor_calibration.sh) |

## Engineering tools

| Tool | Purpose | Entry |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `whl-dyn` | Dynamics calibration, test plans, data collection, offline metrics and Streamlit workbench | [whl-dyn README](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/whl-dyn) |
| `whl-debug` | Controller debugging, online/offline data extraction and issue diagnosis | [whl-debug](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/tools/whl-debug) |
| `whl-tools` | Camera segmentation, image publishing and lane-debug visualization | [whl-tools](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/tools/whl-tools) |
| `whl_toolbox` | Point-cloud, SLAM, sensor and runtime-data visualization | [whl_toolbox](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/tools/whl_toolbox) |
| `whl-can` | CAN automation, static/dynamic cases and vehicle-interface validation | [whl-can](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/tools/whl-can) |
| `whl-mock` | Mock publishing for routing, traffic-light and other inputs | [whl-mock](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/tree/main/modules/tools/whl-mock) |

| Recording and replay | CyberRT recording, message recording, map-data collection and replay | [recording_launcher.py](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/blob/main/scripts/recording_launcher.py) · [record_map_data.py](https://github.com/wheelos/apollo-lite/blob/main/scripts/record_map_data.py) |

## WheelOS data services

Vehicle data should not be scattered as raw files in the Git repository. The following service catalog is a planned product boundary; entries marked pending are not current public download links.

| Service | Intended users | Proposed capability | Current state |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dataset catalog | Algorithm, calibration and test engineers | Search by vehicle, sensor, scenario and version; return dataset ID, time range, topics, format, size and permissions | Entry point pending |
| Raw recording service | Data and test engineers | CyberRT/MCAP upload, ranged download, resume, checksums and lifecycle management | Entry point pending |
| Annotation and sample service | Perception engineers | Sample selection, annotation versions, Lite export formats and train/validation freezing | Entry point pending |
| Replay and evaluation | Validation engineers | Select records, bind code/config, run offline replay and output metrics | Entry point pending |
| Model artifact service | Model and deployment engineers | Models, inference configuration, TensorRT engines, checksums and hardware/driver compatibility | Entry point pending |

APIs should expose `resource_id`, `version`, `source_commit`, `format`, `checksum`, `license`, `access`, `created_at` and `expires_at` so that downloads, replay and evidence records remain traceable.

## WheelOS map services

Map services should provide versioned maps for localization, routing, perception ROI, open-space planning and precision parking rather than a single static archive.

| Service | Capability | Proposed content | Current state |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Map catalog | Discovery and version selection | Area, coordinate frame, coverage, version, update time, compatible vehicles and change history | Entry point pending |
| HD map download | Localization, routing and reference-line planning | `base_map`, `routing_map`, `sim_map`, topology and generation metadata | Entry point pending |
| Parking-map service | Precision parking and open-space planning | Parking slots, lane boundaries, forbidden areas, target poses, ROI and scenario configuration | Entry point pending |
| Map validation and conversion | Pre-release validation | Format conversion, frame checks, topology checks, planning usability and diff reports | Entry point pending |

A map record should include coordinate frame, origin, projection, vehicle constraints, generator version, input-data date, coverage boundary, checksum and rollback version. Map versions must be linked to replay records, planning configuration and vehicle calibration.

## Resource-catalog rules

1. Build the catalog from actual capabilities in `modules/`, `whl-dyn/`, `scripts/` and `wheelos-service/`.
2. Separate models from runnable algorithm packages and tools.
3. Publish code through Git releases and data/maps through permissioned, versioned WheelOS services.
4. Organize entry points by task before module name.
5. Bind every download to an Apollo Lite commit, configuration, model, map, vehicle calibration and evaluation result.

## [zh-CN] 自动驾驶系统版本发布路线图

<!-- source: roadmap/2025.md; route: /roadmap/2025; content_type: roadmap; status_code: planned -->

status: 计划能力

# 自动驾驶系统版本发布路线图

> 本页描述规划目标，不代表所有功能已经交付或完成真实车辆验证。

## Wheel.OS 版本计划

### 版本 12.31

#### 功能

- **核心中间件：** 支持核心功能模块并优化稳定性。
- **Common_msgs 消息接口：** 提供标准消息接口，支持模块间高效通信。
- **传感器驱动：** 增强多种传感器的支持与兼容性。
- **车辆底盘：** 支持底盘控制与调试，提高适配能力。

#### 工具

- **Aconf 配置管理：** 支持灵活的模块配置加载。
- **Cviz 数据可视化：** 实时显示自动驾驶系统关键数据。
- **DBC_tool 底盘适配：** 优化车辆底盘适配流程并提高易用性。
- **底盘调试工具：** 支持底盘系统调试和性能优化。

## Wheel.App 版本计划

### 版本 2.28

#### 功能

- **定位：** 提供基础定位能力。
- **感知：** 建立感知模块基础。
- **预测：** 支持动态目标的基础行为预测。
- **规划：** 实现初始路径规划功能。
- **控制：** 提供车辆控制能力。

#### 工具

- **传感器标定：** 提供传感器初始化和标定工具。
- **传感器时间同步：** 解决多传感器同步问题。
- **车辆动力学标定：** 支持车辆动力学相关参数标定。
- **Carla 集成：** 通过桥接工具与 Carla 仿真器集成。

### 版本 6.30

#### 功能

- **中间件性能优化：** 优化中间件模块运行性能。
- **硬件适配：**
  - 支持 Horizon J6 硬件平台。
  - 支持 NX5 硬件适配。
- **定位：**
  - 提升定位模块性能并支持室内定位。
  - 实现多传感器融合定位。
- **感知：**
  - 优化感知模块性能。
  - 实现语义分割能力。
  - 建立稳健的开发流程。
- **预测：** 提升动态环境中的行为预测能力。
- **规划：**
  - 提供不依赖高精度地图的规划能力。
  - 引入基于路径行为树的决策。
- **控制：** 持续优化车辆控制系统。

#### 运营

- **功能安全：** 推进系统功能安全相关工作。
- **调度系统：** 实现状态监控和任务调度能力。
- **远程驾驶：** 通过高级指令实现远程车辆控制。

#### 工具

- **车辆动力学建模：** 支持基于车辆参数建立动力学模型。

## 总览

| 版本 | 功能 | 工具 | 其他模块 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Wheel.OS 12.31** | 核心中间件、Common_msgs、驱动、车辆 | Aconf、Cviz、DBC_tool、底盘调试 | 无 |
| **Wheel.App 2.28** | 定位、感知、预测、规划、控制 | 传感器标定、时间同步、动力学标定、Carla Bridge | 无 |
| **Wheel.App 6.30** | 中间件优化、硬件适配、定位增强、感知优化、预测、规划、控制 | 车辆动力学建模 | 功能安全、调度系统、远程驾驶 |

## 说明

- 各版本功能按增量优先级推进，用于保持系统稳定性和性能优化。
- 工具模块会根据功能需求持续迭代。
- 运营模块将在后续版本逐步完善，用于支持系统安全和运营管理。

## [en] Autonomous-driving system release roadmap

# Autonomous-driving system release roadmap

> This page describes planned objectives. It does not mean that every feature has shipped or completed real-vehicle validation.

## Wheel.OS release plan

### Version 12.31

#### Features

- **Core middleware:** support core modules and improve stability.
- **Common_msgs:** provide standard message interfaces for efficient module communication.
- **Sensor drivers:** improve support and compatibility for multiple sensors.
- **Vehicle chassis:** enable chassis control and debugging with better adaptation.

#### Tools

- **Aconf:** flexible configuration loading.
- **Cviz:** real-time visualization of key autonomous-driving data.
- **DBC_tool:** improve vehicle-chassis adaptation.
- **Chassis debugging:** support chassis diagnostics and performance tuning.

## Wheel.App release plan

### Version 2.28

- **Features:** basic localization, perception foundation, dynamic-object prediction, initial path planning and vehicle control.
- **Tools:** sensor calibration, sensor time synchronization, vehicle-dynamics calibration and CARLA bridge integration.

### Version 6.30

- **Middleware:** runtime performance optimization.
- **Hardware adaptation:** Horizon J6 and NX5.
- **Localization:** indoor localization and multi-sensor fusion.
- **Perception:** performance improvements, semantic segmentation and a robust development process.
- **Prediction:** improved behavior prediction for dynamic environments.
- **Planning:** map-independent planning and path behavior trees.
- **Control:** continued vehicle-control optimization.
- **Operations:** functional-safety work, dispatch/status management and remote driving.
- **Tools:** vehicle-dynamics modeling.

## Overview

| Version | Features | Tools | Other modules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Wheel.OS 12.31** | Core middleware, Common_msgs, drivers, vehicles | Aconf, Cviz, DBC_tool, chassis debugging | None |
| **Wheel.App 2.28** | Localization, perception, prediction, planning, control | Calibration, time sync, dynamics calibration, CARLA bridge | None |
| **Wheel.App 6.30** | Middleware, hardware, localization, perception, prediction, planning, control | Vehicle-dynamics modeling | Functional safety, dispatch, remote driving |

## Notes

- Features are prioritized incrementally for stability and performance.
- Tool modules evolve with feature requirements.
- Operational modules will be refined in later releases to support safety and fleet operations.

# 自动驾驶短途运输应用场景

> 本页是场景筛选与商业决策指南，不是性能、合规或安全认证承诺。每个项目都需要验证场地、车辆、任务、法规和单位经济性。

<div id="decision-summary"></div>

## 先看结论

WheelOS 聚焦企业内部的**高频、重复、短距离物资运输**。最适合起步的不是“所有无人驾驶”，而是同时具备以下条件的具体运输任务：

- 单程通常不超过约 5 公里，以园区内部、相邻院区或仓库周边为主。
- 每天重复发生，有稳定班次和明确运营主体。
- 起终点、装卸区和交接流程相对固定。
- 路线、车辆、货物、法规和保险边界可以被明确评估。

<div id="scenario-priority"></div>

## 六类场景的进入优先级

| 场景 | 客户任务 | 主要价值 | 建议优先级 | 必须先验证 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 工业制造 | 仓库、车间、产线、成品库之间的物料运输 | 多班次运输、人员投入和车辆调度 | 优先探索 | 室外跨厂房路线、底盘、装卸节拍、安全混行 |
| 医疗物资 | 院区、检验中心、医联体之间的样本与物资运输 | 固定时限、重复往返和交接记录 | 高价值但强合规 | 运输资质、温控、生物安全、包装、全程交接 |
| 商业零售 | 区域仓、配送中心到周边门店的小批量补货 | 多频次补货、门店库存和配送组织 | 区域内先试点 | 门店线路密度、装卸窗口、冷链、城市混行 |
| 仓储物流园区 | 仓库之间、月台与暂存区之间的调拨 | 车辆集中调度、减少短驳人员和车辆空驶 | 较适合 | 园区地图、交通规则、月台节拍、系统接口 |
| 校园与大型园区 | 餐食、布草、耗材等多类后勤运输 | 多任务合并、提高单车利用率 | 需聚合任务 | 任务频率、多楼宇交接、物业运营主体、人车混行 |
| 港口机场与专用区域 | 固定货物摆渡和水平运输 | 大规模、固定区域、专用作业 | 后续项目制 | 专用车辆、场地系统、安全准入、长期运维 |

<div id="manufacturing"></div>

## 场景一：工业制造物料运输

**问题：** 原材料、零部件和半成品在仓库、车间和产线之间持续流动，部分路线很短但班次频繁。

**典型客户：** 汽车零部件、电子制造、家电、机械加工、食品加工企业和工业产业园。

**价值指标：** 每班次运输任务数、司机/搬运人员投入、车辆等待时间、准点率、单位运输成本、夜间和跨车间运输能力。

**商业模式：** 系统采购与车辆适配；固定线路月度服务；按车辆或班次提供自动驾驶系统与运维；客户或物流承包商采购车辆。

**进入条件：** 优先选择室外跨厂房、仓库到车间、跨区域固定线路。任务节拍和装卸流程应从生产计划中可获取，而不是临时调度。

<div id="medical-logistics"></div>

## 场景二：医疗与医药物资运输

**问题：** 医院、检验中心和医联体之间需要高频、小批量、定时运输样本和物资。

**典型客户：** 医院集团、医联体、第三方医学检验中心、医药商业配送企业和社区卫生服务中心。

**价值指标：** 固定时限达成率、每日往返次数、交接完整性、异常响应时间、人工取送投入。

**商业模式：** 固定线路运输合同、按班次或服务量结算、第三方医疗物流服务商采购技术能力、多院区统一运输服务。

**进入条件：** 必须由合规客户或合作运输主体负责运输资质、温控、生物安全、包装、全过程交接和应急处理。自动驾驶系统不能替代这些专业要求。

<div id="retail-replenishment"></div>

## 场景三：商业零售与连锁门店补货

**问题：** 区域仓或配送中心需要向周边门店持续补货，小批量、多频次配送增加组织成本。

**典型客户：** 连锁便利店、生鲜连锁、商超集团、餐饮连锁、中央厨房和供应链企业。

**价值指标：** 配送及时率、门店缺货率、单次配送成本、装载率、车辆周转次数、门店等待时间。

**商业模式：** 固定门店线路服务、按门店/班次/任务计费、车辆租赁或运力使用时间计费、连锁企业统一采购运力。

**进入条件：** 优先评估仓库周边约 5 公里内、可形成线路集群的门店。需要明确装卸窗口、冷链要求、门店交接和城市道路运行边界。

<div id="logistics-campus"></div>

## 场景四：仓储与物流园区内部运输

**问题：** 多个仓库、装卸月台、暂存区和入驻企业之间存在持续短驳需求。

**典型客户：** 仓储运营商、物流园区、批发市场、供应链公司、保税区企业和区域配送中心。

**价值指标：** 调拨次数、月台等待、车辆空驶、统一调度车辆数、任务完成率。

**商业模式：** 固定线路和周期服务、按每日任务或周转量结算、园区统一采购、园区建设共享运输服务。

**进入条件：** 园区应有相对稳定的地图、交通规则和作业接口。客户集中、任务可统一调度时更适合形成运营闭环。

<div id="campus-logistics"></div>

## 场景五：校园、酒店与大型园区后勤

**问题：** 餐食、布草、耗材和设备在楼宇、食堂、仓库和服务区之间持续运输，但单项任务频率可能不高。

**典型客户：** 高校、医院园区、酒店集团、度假区、景区、物业公司和产业园运营方。

**价值指标：** 合并后的任务密度、单车日利用率、跨楼宇交接次数、人工搬运投入。

**商业模式：** 物业或园区统一采购、月度运输服务、多任务整合服务、按线路和作业时段收费。

**进入条件：** 先把餐食、布草、耗材等多项任务组合，证明单车利用率；避免为低频单一业务单独部署车辆。

<div id="specialized-sites"></div>

## 场景六：港口、机场与专用作业区域

**问题：** 港口、机场、铁路货场和能源基地内部存在固定货物摆渡和水平运输。

**典型客户：** 港口、机场、铁路货运中心、能源企业和专用场地运营商。

**价值指标：** 固定区段运输量、车辆利用率、调度集成、停机时间、安全事件和全天候运营能力。

**商业模式：** 项目制系统集成、专用车辆适配、自动驾驶系统授权和长期运维。

**进入条件：** 通常涉及专用车辆、场地作业系统、安全准入和复杂调度，适合作为后续重点客户，而不是早期唯一市场。

<div id="commercial-models"></div>

## 商业模式

商业模式应与车辆所有者、运营主体、承运责任和客户预算匹配。以下是可讨论的合作结构，具体责任以合同为准。

### 客户与 WheelOS 的分工

| 责任方 | 通常负责 | 不能默认承担 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 客户 | 场地、运输任务、车辆或采购计划、装卸交接、运营团队、必要的许可和保险 | 客户业务合规、承运责任和现场运营 |
| WheelOS | 套件配置、软件与接口资料、集成支持、标定与验证建议、可选项报价 | 未经合同约定的物流承运或行业许可 |
| 双方共同确认 | 运行设计域、路线、验收指标、数据与日志、安全边界、项目计划和责任划分 | 任何一方不得把设计建议单方面解释为已验证安全 |

### 可选商业模式

| 模式 | 客户购买什么 | 适合的客户结构 | 关键边界 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 自动驾驶系统采购 | 车辆和系统的适配、部署与技术支持 | 自有车辆和运营团队的客户 | 明确硬件、软件、适配和支持范围 |
| 固定线路运输服务 | 按线路、班次或月度运输量提供服务 | 自有或合作运输商运营 | WheelOS 的技术与承运责任需在合同中区分 |
| 车辆租赁与运力服务 | 按租赁周期或实际使用量购买运力 | 希望减少前期资产投入的客户 | 车辆所有者、保险和事故责任必须明确 |
| 软件与运维订阅 | 自动驾驶系统、车队管理和持续运维 | 多车辆、多线路的运营方 | 功能范围、SLA 和数据责任需确认 |

<div id="fit-checklist"></div>

## 场景准入清单

报价前至少回答：

1. 每天有多少趟任务？是否需要多班次或夜间运行？
2. 当前需要多少司机、搬运人员和车辆？
3. 线路是否固定？是否存在人车混行、临时障碍和复杂路口？
4. 货物是否标准？装卸和交接能否标准化？
5. 谁是预算和采购主体？是否有长期运营计划？
6. 单车每天能完成多少有效任务？
7. 场地或道路是否允许运行？保险、事故责任和监管要求如何安排？

以下情况不应直接进入部署：

- 任务频率低，无法形成稳定利用率。
- 没有明确的运营主体、预算或长期计划。
- 起终点、装卸和交接流程高度不确定。
- 法规、保险或场地安全责任尚未解决。
- 客户只关注“无人驾驶展示”，没有业务指标。

<div id="what-wheelos-provides"></div>

WheelOS 不经营快递揽收、分拣、派件或快递驿站，也不替代医疗、港口、机场等行业的专业合规责任。

<div id="next-steps"></div>

## 下一步

1. 提供场景、车辆、路线、班次、货物和交接方式。
2. 共同筛选任务频率、运营主体、法规和单位经济性。
3. 核对底盘、传感器布置、场地地图、安全和验收指标。
4. 在受控环境中开展最小集成与验证项目。
